title: Provision durable TORCH operations in init/install, not a manual cron step
description: Latest owner clarification: init/install must provision machine-level project services and schedules as one reviewed setup workflow. Current manager schedule JSON is not enough. Include automatic scheduler integration and a manifest-owned service inventory with lifetime (system/session), timezone, missed-run policy, budgets, pause/resume, restart and uninstall behavior. Persistent services survive AI-session expiry; the explicit stopped-until-ready boundary still prevents provider wakes or development dispatch now. Init needs a preview/confirmation path because existing init is read-only; provision dormant services during stopped install, then enable only reviewed policies. Treat TASK-conversation-automatic-scheduler as the earlier narrower request and implement this latest clarification.
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewed init/install provisions or reconciles owned scheduler/service integrations without a separate manual install command
Dormant installation and dry-run never wake providers; persistent approved operations survive manager-session expiry and reboot
Repeated init/install/restore/upgrade cannot duplicate jobs; shutdown/cleanup preserve declared lifetimes and remove only owned integrations
Setup inventories schedule lifetimes; timezones; budgets; restart policy; and destination-specific approval before activation
